crash.description: The terminal process exited unexpectedly. This usually happens if the shell crashes or the PTY is killed by the OS.

links.openFileFailed: Failed to open file from terminal output.

links.openUrlFailed: Failed to open URL from terminal output.

links.pathIsDirectory: Path is a directory, not a file: {{path}}

resume.disconnectedDescription: The saved terminal is unavailable or could not be authorized. Its tab is preserved; retry reconnecting without starting a replacement process.

limits.global_other: Maximum {{formattedCount}} terminals allowed across all projects

lifecycle.closeViewDescription: Hide this view while the process keeps running.

lifecycle.terminateDescription: This stops the live process and removes only its terminal resource. Conversation chat and history are preserved.
lifecycle.conversationScopeRequired: Open a Conversation before creating a durable terminal
lifecycle.scopeError: Terminal requires a valid Conversation scope.
